note: MG-02: discovery verdict predicates, keyed by Stamper registry entry_id. The executor (muster-api/src/services/discoveryService.ts evaluateVerdict) applies an entry's predicate to the get_command's non-empty output: true -> met, false -> not_met, undecidable -> unknown. An entry with no row here, or a row whose expect is null, yields unknown and never prunes a question (src/features/interview/discoveryFactJoin.ts). Predicates live in Muster beside the registry reading, never in Stamper's registry. Each predicate starts from the entry's own verification.evidence criterion and is upgraded to an expected value where the output carries one. live_validation=true marks predicates whose behaviour on a real tenant is unproven (placeholders, Format-Table text, presence-only criteria); MG-19 proves them on the BHD test tenant. Check kinds: json (dot path, case-insensitive keys; equals | in | not_empty | min_items; match all|any over array roots), table (PowerShell Format-Table column; same operators), regex (match = true; W5c3: with equals | in, the first capture group is the value tested and no match is undecidable), all (every check). W5 row fields: on_empty ("not_met": the verdict when the read succeeded and returned nothing; only for an unfiltered read, whose empty list is the tenant's state) and from_entry (judge expect over another entry's output from the same walk; this entry's own read must still succeed). An expect: null row with a W5 basis records why a read that returns output stays undecidable. W5c4: expect { lookup_effect: true } judges the registry entry's own lookup block (source, by_effect) over the block's source list instead of the get_command (muster-api discoveryLookup.ts): met when any object meets every condition, not_met when objects exist and none does, unknown when the list is empty or a condition needs an unresolved variable. W5c5: with from_entry, lookup_effect judges the REFERENCED entry's lookup block over that entry's source read; the block supports op empty and the odata_type field (as Stamper lookup.ts); a Format-Table header that wraps onto several lines is joined per column. W5c6: a lookup block whose condition values name a variable another lookup entry in the walk captures (an Exchange rule on {safeLinksPolicyName} ...) is judged after the walk with the value read off that entry's verdict object; when that entry found no equivalent the rule is recorded awaiting_create (posture unknown) until CES creates the pair. W7-MX1 part 2: on_not_found ("not_met", optional) is the verdict when the read FAILED with a not-found signature (404, ResourceNotFound, Request_ResourceNotFound) and the command had no unresolved {variable}: an optional service that is absent (e.g. Sentinel not onboarded) is an honest not met, recorded with status not_found; without the field, or with a placeholder left in the command, a not-found failure stays failed (unknown). A degradation signature (auth, cmdlet missing) is checked first and is never not_found.

PIM is in use when a role eligibility schedule is provisioned: judged over AZ-ID-005's read (Get-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleEligibilitySchedule -All, no filter). A provisioned schedule -> met; an empty eligibility list -> not_met (no PIM); that read failed or absent -> unknown.

AC.L2-3.1.8.smart-lockout.basis: W5c3: this entry's own read (the authentication methods policy) carries no lockout setting. The tenant's lockout threshold is in the Password Rule Settings directory setting that IA.L2-3.5.8.password-policy-evidence reads (GET /groupSettings, unfiltered), so the predicate judges that read: LockoutThreshold 1-10 -> met (unsuccessful logon attempts are limited, at or below the Entra smart-lockout default); a larger value -> not_met; the setting absent or that read empty / failed -> unknown (the platform default applies but is not read). Whether the value matches the organisation's own threshold (PI.ODP.001) is EO's reconciliation, not this verdict.
AC.L2-3.1.8.smart-lockout.live_reason: Regex over ConvertTo-Json text of the settings name/value list; a real tenant's formatting and the setting's presence are unproven.
